experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer
bullets: Own the merchant settlement service that moves ₹1,800 crore a month for 14,000 merchants; cut failed payouts from 1.9% to 0.4% by redesigning the retry and reconciliation flow.
Designed the public Payouts API (REST and webhooks) used by 60+ merchant integrations; wrote the API reference and migration guides.
Built the feature flag and experiment assignment service the growth team uses for checkout A/B tests; worked with the analyst to read results and decide which variants shipped.
Led the reconciliation rewrite across finance, operations and two partner banks: ran the weekly sync, kept a decision log and wrote the rollout plan.
Write SQL daily against Postgres and BigQuery to investigate payout failures and size incidents; built the settlement health dashboard in Metabase that ops reviews every morning.
Mentor two engineers and run the backend interview loop for the team.

experience.title: Backend Engineer

Raised integration test coverage on the checkout path from 35% to 80% and added contract tests for partner APIs.
Sat in on seller support calls during the returns launch and turned the top complaints into a prioritised fix list for the sprint.
